decision: Selected the site location that the Environment Agency's installations register publishes for permit EPR/VP3225SC (holder VDC LHR21 Limited, 'Vantage LHR21', 37-39 North Acton Road, London NW10 6PF): latitude 51.533022, longitude -0.259746 (grid reference TQ2080483004), copied without transformation, as the project locator. It is the regulator's site point for the permitted installation, not a building outline or surveyed position.

selected_properties.activities: Combustion; Any Fuel =>50MW - 1.1 A(1) a); Medium Combustion Plant collectively =>50MW; Directly Associated Activity
selected_properties.address: 37-39, Vantage LHR21, NORTH ACTON ROAD, LONDON, EALING, NW10 6PF

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published latitude and longitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:27700 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's easting and northing gives 51.5330272, -0.2597529, 0.7 m from the published point.

consistency_checks.postcode_centroid: The ONS centroid of NW10 6PF (postcodes.io: E 520804, N 182994; 51.532939, -0.259733) lies 10 m south of the register point; the London Planning Datahub gives the same E 520804, N 182994 as its UPRN 12117226 site point for the OPDC records at 37-39 North Acton Road. The register point therefore sits close to the postcode point rather than being an independent survey; this is disclosed, and the centroid itself is not used.
consistency_checks.planning_polygon: The Datahub polygon for outline permission 20/0122/OUTOPDC (7 vertices, 0.08 ha, centroid E 520797.85 N 182988.41) is much smaller than the one-acre site Vantage describes and is treated as partial; the register point lies 2.9 m outside it and 16.8 m from its centroid (shapely 2.1.1).
consistency_checks.imagery: Esri World Imagery z17 tiles (x 65440-65444, y 43568-43574; sha256 of the sorted per-tile shasum lines a008e47f0f3f70e6480152b85e664221b08b7e5678110ae74f20b58d8021cf84) viewed locally and not redistributed: the point falls on the roof of a dark multi-storey building with extensive roof plant on the east side of North Acton Road, immediately north of a wooded open space, consistent with the six-storey LHR2 data centre Vantage describes. The imagery date is unknown and is not used as status evidence.
consistency_checks.other_sites: The point is 735 m north-west of the register point for Vantage's LHR11/12 permit at Chandos Road (a separate campus), 255 m from Colt's Powergate permit point and 301 m from Equinix's Powergate permit point (both on Volt Avenue), 404 m from the Atlas Kao Data Park Royal locator and 879 m from the Atlas Pure DC / SEGRO LON02 locator.

uncertainty: The register publishes no positional accuracy, and its point is 10 m from the postcode centroid; the six-storey data centre occupies about half a hectare around the point.
